actual_snapshot_counts_and_hashes_owner: /root/model_schema_702; bind its stable snapshot receipt separately

evidence.claim: Judgment CSV is <opened image folder>/csv/keep_discard.csv with image path, mask path, object count, keep. Reader key is exact stripped image path; duplicate keys last row wins. Verdict true tokens true/1/yes/keep, false tokens false/0/no/discard after lowercase/strip; unknown is None. Missing/unreadable CSV reads as empty.
Recording judgment replaces exact image-path row, writes true/false and current count, rewrites sorted fixed-column whole CSV using temp+replace. No judgment timestamp or event identity column.

Queue resume status is separate curate_status.csv with stem/state/n_objects/updated. Reviewed states done, skip, recropped; other states pending. curate_drafts is ordering metadata, not progress authority.
Inside queue status wins. Only when absent does a compatible sibling <parent>/<queue name>_status.csv become the selected ledger; creating a new inside file can shadow that ledger.

Status read keys are stripped stems, duplicate last row wins, state normalized, invalid count becomes None. Whole CSV rewrite preserves mapping including absent stems. Default updated is naive local datetime to second, not UTC.
Layout detection rejects duplicate field stems because resume state is keyed by stem.

Optional exclude_verdicts scans queue/images folder judgment CSVs, recognizes both verdict polarities and reduces path to basename stem without file-identity/existence validation. This differs from exact-path current UI verdict lookup. build_queue defaults exclude_verdicts=False; runtime selection parameters remain unobserved.
Mask save marks status done only for an open queue. A status-write exception is logged after the mask save. An ordinary folder open has no queue resume write.

Keep/Discard first invokes save-if-needed and boxes save, then records judgment and moves next. Discard is not Skip and deletes nothing. Save-if-needed returning True does not by itself prove pixels saved.
Save-on-navigation unchecked returns True without dirty-mask persistence. Skip writes queue skip and advances with save_mask=False, leaving mask disk bytes unchanged; folder-only Skip does nothing.
Explicit unchanged save still marks done without rewriting mask; changed save writes mask/log then marks done. done therefore does not prove a pixel edit or a Keep judgment.
Normal load prefers masks/<stem>.tif then masks/<original filename> then masks/<stem>.tiff. Missing mask loads zero labels. Sibling masks_dir override and seg bundle branch are distinct.
Canonical normal save destination is <masks dir>/<image stem>.tif; seg bundle writes into itself.
Mask write precedes whole sidecar write when nonempty log supplied. Ordinary save makes no separate original-mask backup. No all-file atomic transaction with status/verdict is established.
Sidecar is full artifact filename plus .curation.json. is_curated inspects only sidecar: nonempty edits true, missing false, malformed true conservatively, even if artifact absent/unreadable.

Edit entries hold kind/target/when/who/n_changed/detail. Default when is UTC second-resolution; user name is attribution, not verified identity. Log history can include undo; nonempty history does not prove final pixels differ from original.
Sidecar schema version 1 has artifact/source/edits. Whole JSON is rewritten by temp+replace; API append-only history is not filesystem append and not a pixel undo/original-mask archive.

Opening seeds whole log from canonical-mask sidecar, retains existing artifact/source strings. Unreadable log becomes new empty log after warning; a subsequent edited save may replace damaged history.
Edit recording is initially in memory. Optional manual_mask_sha256 is label-array shape+little-endian int64 hash, not mask-file SHA or universal before-state payload.
Recrop archive names are recropped_originals and recropped.json. This source does not establish why an actual _withdrawn file exists; preserve and bind its own provenance separately.

authority_by_aspect.judgment: exact-image-path row in selected opened-folder csv/keep_discard.csv
authority_by_aspect.queue_resume: selected status_path ledger keyed stem; done/skip/recropped eligibility
authority_by_aspect.current_pixels: resolved actual canonical mask or bundle bytes, not status/verdict object count
authority_by_aspect.edit_provenance: sidecar paired to full resolved mask filename; preserve whole history
authority_by_aspect.derived_metadata: build manifest/README/build summary/index/order caches require their own build-time bindings and are not current progress authority merely by filename

conflict_and_preservation_keys: Bind queue layout and image content identity before mapping path or stem across hosts; equal path/count/mtime does not establish identical dataset.

Judgment conflict key is exact image path in that ledger; status conflict key is field stem. Retain both versions of conflicting same-key records for explicit resolution; do not choose using unrelated timestamps.

Judgment has no timestamp; status default timestamps are naive local; sidecar times are UTC with second granularity and no default unique edit ID. Neither timestamps nor object counts prove version ancestry.
Sidecar artifact/source may retain old absolute paths after relocation. Compare relative file association and hashes before authorized mapping; old metadata path alone does not prove wrong pixels.

Keep current masks, alternate candidate mask filenames, complete sidecars, status, verdicts, source image identity, derived provenance, and special withdrawn/recrop files until their roles are bound. Ordinary saves do not preserve original mask pixels automatically.
Duplicate CSV keys are read last-row-wins; that is current reader behavior, not a safe cross-host merge policy.
No copy, merge, synchronization, initialization or remapping is performed by this receipt. Home continuation requires separately verified stable data receipt and authorized integration plan.
limitations: No application, Qt, CLI, mask decoder, pickle loader, tests, model or GPU execution. No queue read/write by this author; source-only engineering metadata.
No current UI save-on-navigation setting, open-folder versus queue mode, command flags, process state, user action completion, unsaved RAM edits or runtime persistence outcome inferred.
No biological-label validity, annotation correctness, training/inference readiness, or completed count asserted.
Actual queue intersections/counts belong teammate stable snapshot; they cannot be derived from these source branches alone.
No universal transaction/concurrency-lock guarantee. Each temp+replace rewrite is per file; mask, log, status and judgment can disagree after interrupted writes or differing user actions.
